news.title: SLU Researcher Serves as Scientist in Residence for the Saint Louis Science Center's 'The Blue Whale Story,' Which Opens Saturday
news.summary_en: SLU professor of physics Jean Potvin, Ph.D., has spent years studying the science of whales. Soon, St. Louis residents can hear directly from him. As a part of the Saint Louis Science Center's new traveling exhibition, The Blue Whale Story, opening this weekend, Potvin is serving as scientist in residence.

news.title: College of Arts and Sciences Recognizes Faculty and Staff Excellence
news.summary_en: The Saint Louis University College of Arts and Sciences bestows annual awards to honor faculty and staff for a wide range of achievements.

news.title: Student Health's 'Billiken Nurse' Named Outstanding Nursing Professional
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University Student Health Center nurse Elise Molner brings the Jesuit value of cura personalis to student care on campus.
